item.text:
Every requirement maps to planned work below. Letters refer to the proposed tickets; none have been created yet.

| Source | Requirement | Coverage and acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Brief · First version 1 | Apply for the coming season with up to three preferred plots | **E:** phone application journey; rejects duplicate preferences and more than three choices; retry does not duplicate applications |
| Brief · First version 2 | Coordinator allocates plots and waitlists unallocated applicants in application order | **F, G:** allocation walkthrough; complete queue population; tests for delayed waitlisting, vacancies, and ordering |
| Brief · First version 3 | Gardener sees allocation and season dates | **D, H:** season records and gardener view; checks across pending, waitlisted, allocated, and released states |
| Brief · First version 4 | Gardener reports a plot problem; coordinator views and resolves it | **K, L:** own-plot authorization, submission retry, open-report list, and persistent resolution |
| Brief · First version 5 | Coordinator sees a grid of all 40 plots and their holders | **D, I:** exactly 40 plots; accurate occupied/free states and holder labels; coordinator-only access |
| Brief · Rules | At most one plot per household per season | **C, D, F:** household confirmation and duplicate reconciliation; database constraints and concurrent-allocation tests |
| Brief · Rules | Prior-season holders applying before February 1 take priority over new applicants | **D, F:** prior-holder records; timezone-aware cutoff tests; new allocations cannot finalize prematurely |
| Brief · Rules | Waiting list is strictly first come, first served | **E, G:** immutable application receipt order; stable tie-break; vacancy assignment checks all eligible unallocated applications |
| Brief · Constraints | Works on phones | **A, B, E–I, K–L, O:** prototype review and complete phone journeys |
| Brief · Constraints | Contact details visible only to coordinator | **C**, authorization throughout feature tickets, **O:** cross-household and role-denial tests; no contact details in digest emails or logs |
| Brief · Constraints | Large text, plain language, usable by people with low technology confidence | **B, O**, all interface tickets: owner prototype review, readable layouts, clear messages, keyboard and screen-reader checks |
| Your sign-in decision | Emailed one-time links; no passwords | **C, N, O:** expiry, single use, resend, secure sessions, and controlled-inbox delivery verification |
| Your notification decision | One daily email listing new problem reports | **M, N, O:** daily scheduling, persistent delivery state, retry/catch-up tests, and staging delivery verification |
| Brief · Later | Online plot-fee payment | **Explicitly deferred**; no first-version implementation ticket |
| Brief · Later | Shared tool-lending shelf | **Explicitly deferred**; no first-version implementation ticket |

Supporting work and assumptions are separate from brief requirements:

| Supporting work or assumption | Owner |
|---|---|
| Application, database, prototype, and verification tooling | **A** |
| Coordinator-confirmed households; merge preserves original application order | **C, F, G** |
| Default March 1–October 31 dates; configurable garden timezone | **D** |
| 09:00 daily digest; no email on days without new reports | **M** |
| Hosting/email selection, backups, restore, retention/deletion, and staging | **N** |
| Complete verification before production release | **O → Q** |
| Owner reviews prototype, allocation milestone, and first-version acceptance | **B, J, P** |

All first-version requirements are covered; no scope or dependencies changed during this inspection. Checkpoints remain ordinary tickets, without mechanically enforced owner-approval gates.

Review not rerun: displaying the coverage map changes no ticket's scope, dependencies or responsibilities.

Independent review: revise, invocation R2

Setup remains unwritten pending package approval, as required by the [story setup flow](/private/tmp/cc-cpm-w4-t536/onboarding-eval-7sJ9ku/home/.agents/skills/story/setup-flow.md): “Nothing is written before approval.”
